title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Centre College
description: Late-night dining options for Centre College students in Danville, ranging from on-campus cafes to local 24-hour staples.

cards.title: Late Night at the Flame
cards.subtitle: Roush Campus Center
cards.notes: Located on the first floor of the Roush Campus Center, this spot offers mobile ordering for late-night snacks until midnight daily.
cards.short_summary: On-campus retail dining venue offering late-night mobile ordering and pick-up for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Flame Café is open 7 days a week with mobile order/pick-up only from 9:00 pm to 12:00 midnight.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight daily for mobile orders; accessible to students with meal plans or flex dollars.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Classic
cards.subtitle: Hustonville Road
cards.notes: A reliable 24/7 destination for breakfast food and late-night study breaks just a short drive from campus.
cards.short_summary: Iconic 24-hour diner serving breakfast and comfort food at all hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House locations are open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including the Danville location.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; located approximately 1.5 miles south of the main campus.

cards.title: The Late-Night Tray
cards.subtitle: South Danville Bypass
cards.notes: Famous for its extensive milkshake menu and affordable trays, this drive-thru stays open until 3 AM or later.
cards.short_summary: Fast-food chain known for low-cost trays and late-night operating hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Out is open until 3:00 AM or 4:00 AM on weekends, providing a primary late-night option for students.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 3 AM Sunday-Thursday and 4 AM Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: Fourth Meal Run
cards.subtitle: Hustonville Road
cards.notes: A staple for late-night cravings, the drive-thru serves students until 3 AM most nights.
cards.short_summary: Popular fast-food destination for late-night Mexican-inspired fare.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell in Danville is open until 3:00 AM Sunday-Thursday and 4:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 3 AM or 4 AM depending on the day.

cards.title: Midnight McNuggets
cards.subtitle: Jane Trail
cards.notes: The Jane Trail location provides late-night service for students seeking quick burgers and fries until midnight.
cards.short_summary: Global fast-food chain offering late-night drive-thru service in Danville.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's in Danville employs closers until 12:00 AM, indicating late-night availability.

cards.title: The Study Session Pizza
cards.subtitle: East Main Street
cards.notes: Conveniently located near campus, this Domino's is a go-to for late-night delivery during finals week.
cards.short_summary: Pizza delivery and carryout service located within walking distance of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's on East Main Street offers delivery and carryout with hours extending late into the evening.
cards.access_notes: Open late for delivery and carryout; check app for specific nightly closing times.

cards.title: Late Night Slushes
cards.subtitle: Baughman Avenue
cards.notes: Students head here for half-price drinks and snacks, with the drive-in stalls open until midnight.
cards.short_summary: Drive-in restaurant offering a full menu and specialty drinks late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonic Drive-In in Danville is open until 12:00 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight every day of the week.

cards.title: The Frosty Run
cards.subtitle: Hustonville Road
cards.notes: A popular choice for a late-night Frosty or burger, with drive-thru service available until midnight.
cards.short_summary: Fast-food restaurant providing late-night drive-thru service on the south side of town.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's on Hustonville Road has drive-thru hours until 12:00 AM daily.

cards.title: Late Night Sushi & Burgers
cards.subtitle: South Danville Bypass
cards.notes: A local favorite for late-night dining, offering a full menu of burgers and sushi until 11 PM or midnight.
cards.short_summary: Restaurant and bar with a diverse menu and late-night dining hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Drake's in Danville is open until 11:00 PM Sunday-Thursday and 12:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight on weekends; under-21 safe for dining.

cards.title: Late Night Carryout
cards.subtitle: West Main Street
cards.notes: Located just blocks from campus, this pizza spot is a frequent choice for late-night carryout orders.
cards.short_summary: Pizza chain offering delivery and carryout options near the Centre College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa John's on West Main Street is open until 11:00 PM, serving as a late-evening option.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM; located within walking distance of campus.
